bridge.when: Uncertain: some before Isa, some after
text: The Quran also tells stories that sit outside the line of prophets, or whose time no one can fix. They are told as lessons for those who reflect.

Here are young men who slept for centuries in a cave, a just king who travelled to the ends of the earth, a proud man and his garden, brothers who would not share their harvest, a land ruined by ingratitude, a town that rejected its messengers, a man who slept a hundred years, and a father's advice to his son.
